meta.title: Ahmedabad Urban Heat Island Mitigation & PINN Modeling

day_night.orbit_overpass: Daytime sun-synchronous (~10:30 AM local solar time)
day_night.explanation: Existing project datasets contain daytime observations from USGS Landsat 8/9 only. Separate nighttime thermal observations (e.g. MODIS Terra/Aqua MOD11A2/MYD11A2, VIIRS, or ECOSTRESS) are not present in the current dataset repository.

provenance.buildings: Synthetic prototype (4,777 buildings in study area from D:\395_buildings.csv)
provenance.satellite: Calibrated offline synthetic proxy (Earth Engine offline)
provenance.validation: 8.0 km Contiguous Spatial Block Holdout (28 train blocks, 10 test blocks)

cool_roofs.description: High-albedo solar reflection on rooftop surfaces (SRI ≥ 78).

green_roofs.description: Extensive sedum/vegetative rooftop conversion with evapotranspirative cooling.

urban_trees.description: Street-level canopy expansion and urban forestry corridors (NDVI +0.15).

combined.description: Integrated reflective roofs, green roofs, and tree corridors with non-linear saturation.
